---
name: Feature request
about: Track new capabilities for StageHand’s manager, member, or crowd experiences.
title: "[feature] "
labels: type:feature
assignees: []
---

## Summary
Describe the new capability you want to add. What is the observable experience for the manager, band member, or crowd?

## Why
Explain why this feature matters. What problem does it solve, and how will we know the impact (e.g., request volume, tip capture, smoother handoffs)?

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] List measurable outcomes so we know when the work is done (e.g., crowd tablets show updated queue within 3 seconds).
- [ ] Describe UI/verbal copy expectations, navigation flows, and any cross-role dependencies.

## Implementation notes
- Share relevant screens/components (e.g., `ManagerView`, `CrowdView`) or API endpoints.
- Mention data model changes if new CRUD objects are needed.

## Testing
- Outline manual or automated tests to verify the feature.
